details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST of install metadata — package name, hostname, install path, working directory and npm/node user agent — as JSON to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header. index.js repeats the same callback when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. No credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents are collected or transmitted; the only data sent is host and install metadata.
